mapper.sql: PRODUCT_ID AS productId, PRODUCT_CODE AS productCode, PROVIDER_NAME AS providerName, PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, SUMMARY AS summary, DESCRIPTION AS description, RATE_MIN_PCT AS rateMinPct, RATE_MAX_PCT AS rateMaxPct, LIMIT_MAX_AMT AS limitMaxAmt, TERM_TEXT AS termText, REPAYMENT_METHOD AS repaymentMethod, MIN_ALT_SCORE AS minAltScore, ELIGIBILITY_TEXT AS eligibilityText, REQUIRED_DOCUMENTS AS requiredDocuments, CAUTION_TEXT AS cautionText, DUMMY_YN AS dummyYn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM LOAN_PRODUCT ORDER BY PRODUCT_ID
SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, WORKER_TYPE_CODE AS workerTypeCode FROM LOAN_PRODUCT_WORKER_TYPE ORDER BY PRODUCT_ID, WORKER_TYPE_CODE
SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, FEATURE_TEXT AS featureText FROM LOAN_PRODUCT_FEATURE ORDER BY PRODUCT_ID, DISPLAY_ORDER
SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, WORKER_TYPE_CODE AS workerTypeCode FROM LOAN_PRODUCT_WORKER_TYPE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY WORKER_TYPE_CODE
SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, FEATURE_TEXT AS featureText FROM LOAN_PRODUCT_FEATURE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER
SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM LOAN_PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_CODE = #{productCode}
SELECT P.PRODUCT_CODE FROM LOAN_PRODUCT_FAVORITE F JOIN LOAN_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = F.PRODUCT_ID WHERE F.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC, P.PRODUCT_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LOAN_PRODUCT_FAVORITE (USER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, CREATED_AT) SELECT #{userId}, #{productId}, #{now} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LOAN_PRODUCT_FAVORITE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PRODUCT_ID = #{productId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM LOAN_PRODUCT_FAVORITE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
